intent: Arrange an ordered group of blocks in responsive size-class bands without asking callers for spans.
typical_uses: A group of dashboard blocks with shared responsive sizing rules
An ordered collection of mixed high and low panels

invariants.text: Items keep input DOM order while the grid places each size class's preferred span at each container step, or an in-range span when flexible.
The outer wrapper is a named inline-size container; step rules are scoped to the config name.

anti_patterns.dont: Put a fragment or wrapper between Grid and GridItem
anti_patterns.do_instead: Pass direct GridItem elements or arrays of them.

anti_patterns.dont: Reuse a layoutId within one Grid
anti_patterns.do_instead: Give every item its own layoutId; Grid keys items and placements by it.

anti_patterns.dont: Render a custom config without the step CSS generated for it
anti_patterns.do_instead: Run frontx-ui-grid-css on the config and import the stylesheet once.

children.states: children are direct GridItem elements, arrays, or empty conditional entries
children.because: ReactNode includes wrappers, fragments, and text that Grid rejects at runtime.

config.states: config is a GridConfig shared with its generated step CSS, including the fixed row track
config.because: The schema cannot express the nested step-to-size-range relationship or CSS generation contract.

cannot_extract: default: prop "config" defaults to "defaultGridConfig", which is not a literal - the body gives no single literal default for it
